claims.claim: You can submit a deputy report online.
claims.quote: If your deputy report is due today, it can be submitted once the service is back online.
claims.note: The source describes digital deputy reporting but states the service was temporarily unavailable when fetched.

claims.claim: You can submit a deputy report by post.
claims.quote: Send your completed form to: Office of the Public Guardian PO Box 16185 Birmingham B2 2WH
claims.note: The deputy report form guidance gives a postal submission address.
